key_catalyst: Escalating US-Iran tensions disrupt oil shipments in the Strait of Hormuz, driving oil prices up amid persistent 3.9% super-core inflation.
reasoning: Track A (Escalation Override) applies because the US-Iran conflict has escalated from diplomatic breakdowns and localized strikes to the physical disruption of oil shipments in the Strait of Hormuz. This is a novel, CRITICAL supply shock that directly exacerbates the persistent 3.9% super-core inflation reported in today's CPI preview, creating a severe macro headwind for QQQ that the market has not previously absorbed.
